namespace MyApp.Config;

/// <summary>
/// Compile-time set of [Sensitive] configuration keys; masks their audit values.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class MyAppConfigurationSensitiveKeyClassifier : global::Pragmatic.Configuration.ISensitiveKeyClassifier
{
    private static readonly global::System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string> SensitiveKeys =
        new(global::System.StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        {
            "Payment:ApiKey",
            "Payment:WebhookSecret",
        };
    
    public bool IsSensitive(string key)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
            return false;
        int slash = key.LastIndexOf('/');
        string logical = slash >= 0 ? key.Substring(slash + 1) : key;
        return SensitiveKeys.Contains(logical);
    }
}
